buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to

50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. 1.1 Revised technical specification for Repair of Solar Kiln ​1. Repair of existing glass structure, including replacemen t of broken/damaged glazing and modification to double w alled in metal with 5 mm glass wherever required, comple te with necessary gaskets, sealants and fittings. ​2. Repair, finishing and making existing RCC/concrete fou ndation extension of platform size as per requirement and surface finishing including painting. ​​3. Supply, installation and commissioning of temperature and humidity control system with suitable sensors, control lers and display, including wiring, terminations and calibra tion. ​4. Supply and installation of 8-10 nos. heater elements of approx20KW with suitable supports, connections and cabl e connection with suitable rating from nearest point. ​5. Design, fabrication and installation of kiln cover using w aterproof polyester fabric or other suitable material, includ ing supporting frame, fixing hardware. ​6. Supply and installation of finned sheet/collector plate fo r heat collection inside the kiln, painted with high heat abs orption, fixed on suitable supports. ​7. Construction/provision of north wall in wood board, or o ther nonconductive insulating material to minimize heat lo ss, including framing. ​8. Providing partition/enclosure for fan and air circulation path, including framing, sheeting. ​9. Supply and fixing of GI sheets inside the kiln sheathing for East, West, South walls including necessary overlaps, F asteners. ​10. Providing and fixing name /sign board of size 5’×3’. 2 Accessories, spares and consumables (if any) 2.1 .. 3 Standards, Safety, Warranty and Training (if any) 3.1 FDA, CE, ISO, UL or BIS certified: 3.2 Comprehensive warranty (Years): 3.3 AMC after Warranty (Years): 4 Documentation (if any) 4.1 Catalogue/Pamphlet/Literature ..

5 Supply Type (Supply/Installation/Testing/Commissioning) 5.1 6 Special Terms& Condition (if any) 6.1 Terms and Conditions 1) USE OF SPARE PARTS Unless otherwise agreed, the Contractor shall only use parts of the Original brand or parts of equivalent quality when carrying out the repair work. The Transport of equipment and risk of loss or damage to Equipment while outside the Customer’s premises for the purpose of repair shall be borne by the service provider. The Con tractor shall give appropriate notice In Writing to the Customer about the time an d means of transport of the repaired Equipment from and to the Customer’s prem ises. 2) TESTING OF THE REPAIR WORK - Repair should be conducted as per standar d accepted guideline for equipment repair. The Contractor shall there after assist the Customer to carry out such tests as have been agreed upon or as are reasona bly required in order to ascertain that the repair work has been successfully comp leted . 3) PAYMENT- Payment will be done after the successful completion of the work/se rvices. No advance payment will be do ne for the same. No extra payment will be done for the inspection visits. 4) General Inst:- Repair should be done in the Buyer premises, as far as possible. If it is necessary to take equipments to the work- shop, the transport of equipmen t and risk of loss or damage to Equipment while outside the Customer’s premises for the purpose of repair shall be borne by the service provider. All repair services are time bound activities and to be completed as per user assigned timeframe, ot herwise it is the responsibility of t he bidder/ firm to provide an alternative arrang ement at their cost. No charges will be paid for taking Instrument/equipment to w orkshop and reinstallation in the premises 5) Guarantee/Warranty:- The Vendor shall warrant that all material supplied/serv ices provided under the Order shall be new, unused requirements and specificatio ns as mentioned in the BID. The Vendor shall guarantee the material under the Or der for a period of 12 months from the date of delivery. The date of delivery to be

reckoned as the date of receipt of the material at site by the consignee. The Vend or shall agree to replace any material, which has been proved defective or fails to conform to the desired specifications free of cost to the Purchaser within the Guar antee/Warranty Period. The guarantee period for such replaced part shall be the s ame as that of materials specified earlier. Inspection and acceptance of material, by consignee and Third Party shall not in any way relieve the Vendor from the res ponsibility for proper performance during the guarantee period. Guarantee/warra nty certificate is mandatory for all items supplied 6) Working time: The Work on the equipment should be carried out during norma l working hours on working days, however in emergency at any time of the day. 7) Technical Specifications: The Seller guarantees to meet the specifications as per GEM CONTRACT and to incorporate the modifications to the existing design, c onfiguration to meet the specific requirement of the Buyer services as per modific ations/ requirement recommended by the Consignee. 8) Dispute Redressal: The contract is based on mutual trust and confidence. Bot h the parties agree to carry out the assignment in good faith. If any dispute or diff erence of any kind what so ever (the decision whereof is not hearing otherwise pr ovided for) shall arise between the FRI and the bidder in connection with or arisin g out of the contract, whether during the contract period or completion and whet her before or after the termination, abandonment or breach of the contract, shall be refer to and settled sole arbitration of the Director, Forest Research Institute, Dehradun. Who shall give written award of his decision to the bidder the decision of the Director FRI will be final and binding. 9) In case of any disputes on execution of the work during the period of contract, t he decision of the Director, ICFRE-FRI Dehradun shall be binding and final, agreea ble in full by both the parties. 10) Preventive maintenance visits and any number of breakdown visits are absolut ely free of cost . 11) In case, the contractor notices any part of the equipment missing, the same sh all be brought to the not ice of the officer In-Charge and HOD, otherwise responsi bility for the same will be fixed on the contractor/s ervice provider. 12) Repairs to be undertaken should be within specified configuration and maintaini ng the integration on internal circuit of equipment, any deviation on configuration / specification the repair will not be acceptable. 13) Contract holder will not be allowed to sublet the work to any other agency.

14) NON-DEBARMENT-The Service Provider/Agency should have not been debarred / black listed / terminated / ceased without completing the entire duration of cont ract period by any Central/State Govt. Department, 15) Director, ICFRE-FRI Dehradun reserves the right to cancel the contract at any ti me without assigning any reasons whatsoever. 16) Bidder must upload the compliance certificate of the above Scope of Work along with compliance of all the bid terms and conditions. . 6.
